summary.headline: Natco Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue fell to Rs794.4 crore from Rs1,390.6 crore, as lower net exports offset double-digit base business growth.
summary.overview: Consolidated total revenue was Rs794.4 crore against Rs1,390.6 crore a year earlier, mainly due to lower net export revenue in the quarter. EBITDA including other income was Rs245.7 crore at a 30.9% margin, helped by international and domestic business performance and lower operating costs. Consolidated PAT was Rs206.5 crore versus Rs269 crore in Q4 FY26, which included a one-time Rs115 crore deferred tax benefit. Share of profit from the associate Advanced Organics (South Africa) was Rs84.3 crore, and Natco raised its stake to 49% in July 2026 after acquiring 13.25%.

segments.name: Export / international formulations
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs477 crore as stated in Q&A, down QoQ; management attributed the decline to order timing and tender pricing, with constant-currency QoQ decline of about 14% per analyst. Brazil Rs138 crore and Canada Rs56 crore.

segments.name: Domestic formulations
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs126 crore; management said base business runs at about Rs107 crore per quarter and grew to around Rs100-plus crore in the quarter (figures as transcribed, unclear).

segments.name: Advanced Organics (associate, South Africa)
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs1,582.8 crore and PAT Rs242.2 crore in the quarter; Natco share of profit Rs84.3 crore. Management said about 20-25% of Natco's revenue now comes from Advanced Organics.

segments.name: Crop health sciences
segments.commentary: Q1 revenue about Rs14 crore and a loss for the quarter; FY26 total was about Rs138 crore. Management expects Q2 and Q3 to be much stronger, with Q2 the peak season.

guidance_outlook: Crop health: management expects Q2 significantly better than Q1 and Q2 and Q3 to approach the FY26 total of about Rs138 crore, but gave no firm annual number.
Tax: India effective tax rate about 25.6% under the new regime, about 27% including surcharges and other items; consolidated rate varies with country mix.
Other expenses: Q1 is lower than Q4 and last year's Q1 had high R&D and legal costs; management said Q1 is not a run-rate and spend will rise going forward.
Organic capex about Rs250-300 crore per year over the next two years.
Demerger of the crop health business could be delayed by two to three months because of the fundraise, moving the timeline from about December to about March.
capex_capacity: Organic capex of about Rs250-300 crore per year, per management.
Cash of about Rs1,400 crore after roughly Rs3,000 crore of investments over the past year, mainly the Advanced Organics stake purchases.
Management is exploring acquisitions and plans a fundraise (options include QIP or rights, not finalised).
Semaglutide dossiers are filed in Canada and Brazil; India and South Africa launch timing not confirmed.
demand_pricing: Export revenue was down QoQ in constant currency by about 14% per analyst; management attributed this to order timing and tender pricing across products.
Domestic base business run-rate is about Rs107 crore per quarter, with management expecting to sustain it.
Crop health: about 35 products, of which 8 are CTPR-related and contribute about 30-35% of crop health revenue; BLANCE is a key fungicide.
Semaglutide generic faces intense competition in India, with a 'fairly high-priced' launch environment; the brand is still loss-making, per management.

qa_highlights.question: What are the constant-currency growth rates for Canada and Brazil, and what drove the QoQ export decline?
qa_highlights.answer: Brazil revenue was Rs138 crore, up about 180%, and Canada about Rs56 crore. Management attributed the QoQ export decline to order timing across geographies and said the Advanced Organics profit share was the main source of earnings.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other expenses fall sharply, and is this a sustainable run-rate?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said last year's Q1 had high R&D and legal spend. R&D is lumpy and batch-driven, so Q1 is not a run-rate and spend will rise in future quarters.

qa_highlights.question: What is the cash plan and reason for the fundraise?
qa_highlights.answer: Net cash was about Rs1,400 crore after roughly Rs3,000 crore of investments over the past year, with loan repayments and capex to fund. Management is also evaluating acquisitions and wants cash ready for opportunities.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of the olaparib litigation and the Brazil/Karsten-Zomit launches?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the Karsten-Zomit launch is on track for calendar 2027 after the settlement. For olaparib, exclusivity arguments are still open and a decision is expected in the next few months.

qa_highlights.question: What is the tax rate outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: India is about 25% under the new regime, with about 27% including surcharges and other items. The consolidated rate depends on country mix, and Q1 was high because of lower profit from higher-tax geographies.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook for Advanced Organics (South Africa), and is more stake likely?
qa_highlights.answer: Synergies are being pursued through pipeline transfers and Indian partner relationships. Natco now holds 49% after buying 13.25% in July 2026, and management said a further increase would depend on a right-of-first-refusal opportunity arising.

risks_watch: Export revenue volatility from order timing and tender pricing; constant-currency QoQ decline of about 14%.
Crop health remains loss-making in Q1 and depends on a strong Q2 monsoon season; the company also flagged a delay from a late monsoon.
Olaparib exclusivity litigation is unresolved; the outcome timing is uncertain.
Demerger timing may slip to about March due to the fundraise.
Quarterly tax rate volatility from country mix and one-time items.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the Advanced Organics stake, the base business and crop health's Q2 recovery, but evasive on specific figures, launch dates and litigation timelines. Several answers were vague or repeated, and some numbers were hard to verify from the transcript.
